info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Events Ticketing Tickets Validates-v3-spec
info.description: The Validate Event Tickets API allows businesses to verify the validity of tickets for various events. This endpoint checks the status and authenticity of specified tickets, ensuring they meet established criteria. Ideal for event organizers and ticketing platforms, it streamlines operations by preventing issues related to fraudulent or expired tickets. Accessible for integration within mobile applications and web platforms, this API enhances user trust and satisfaction by providing immediate feedback on ticket legitimacy.

get.description: This operation allows you to validate a ticket by checking its status and verifying its authenticity. It helps ensure that the ticket is valid for entry and has not been tampered with.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate ticket information before processing. It contains the necessary details to ensure that the ticket is valid and meets the required criteria.

200.description: Validation successful; ticket parameters are correct.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesReque.description: Represents the request body for validating tickets in the GET operation. This string should contain the necessary ticket validation data.

status.description: Indicates the status of the ticket validation.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The unique identifier of the validation result.

state.description: The current state of the ticket validation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the validation in milliseconds.

message.description: Any relevant messages regarding the ticket validation.

audit.description: Detailed information about the audit of the validation process.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesRespo.description: Schema representing the successful response for ticket validation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the ticket validation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket validation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the ticket validation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Schema representing audit details of the ticket validation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. Higher values may indicate increased load or inefficient processing.
